neighbours.label: The comma that closes a subordinate or concessive clause and is followed by a 'you' main clause ('though your circumstances may vary[,] you can be models…'), and the quote opening reported speech
fire: Though your circumstances may differ and your opportunities may vary, you can be models to follow.
Try not to lie down too soon after a meal. Raise the head of your pillow by about thirty degrees.
Whatever you do for work, wherever you live, you can find a small way to help others.
When you arrive at the station, ask the clerk which platform your train leaves from.
If you are feeling tired after lunch, you should take a short walk outside in the fresh air.
Even if you have never cooked before, you will find that this recipe is quick and forgiving.
However busy your week may be, you can still set aside ten minutes each evening to read.
Think of the circus and think of magic. What comes to your mind?
quiet: Though their circumstances may differ and their opportunities may vary, they can be models to follow.
The patient should not lie down too soon after a meal. The head of the pillow is raised by thirty degrees.
Whatever he did for work, wherever he lived, he found a small way to help others.
When the travellers arrived at the station, the clerk told them which platform the train left from.
If the boy was feeling tired after lunch, he would take a short walk outside in the fresh air.
Even if she had never cooked before, she found that the recipe was quick and forgiving.
However busy the week had been, the family still set aside ten minutes each evening to read.
The circus brought magic to the town, and the children talked about it for days.

notes: The output direction suppresses 'you' and promotes they/he/we; fire sentences set up a second-person continuation, near misses a third-person one.
